description: This file contains the implementation of the Response class conforming to PSR-7 standards, providing HTTP response functionality including status code, reason phrase, headers, and body handling.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Implements PSR-7 ResponseInterface, representing an HTTP response with status, headers, and body.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Response object with status code, headers, body, protocol version, and optional reason phrase.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the response.

methods.name: getReasonPhrase
methods.description: Returns the reason phrase associated with the status code.

methods.name: withStatus
methods.description: Returns a new Response with the specified status code and optional reason phrase.
